nodes.label: POS Application Favicon SVG Icon
nodes.description: A lightning bolt / flash-shaped favicon icon (48x46px SVG). The primary shape is a two-segment zigzag lightning bolt filled with vivid purple (#863bff). Layered on top via an alpha mask are multiple blurred ellipses in deep purple (#7e14ff), soft lavender (#ede6ff), and cyan-blue (#47bfff), creating a glowing, luminous shimmer effect. Serves as the browser tab favicon and application branding mark for the POS system.
